name: chatos-web-design-studio
description: AI-first visual website design with editable Scene artboards, visual review, and human collaboration.

interface.longDescription: An AI-first website design workbench where AI builds visually reviewed pages in bounded steps and people inspect, annotate, arrange, and refine stable Scene layers across linked page, overlay, menu, and state artboards.
capabilities: AI-first one-page-at-a-time and one-step-at-a-time visual generation
Chromium screenshots, stable visual grounding, visual Diffs, and Design Gate review
Editable recursive Scene layers with stable IDs and exact revision history
Independent page, modal, drawer, popover, menu, and state artboards
Prototype links and visible flow arrows between artboards
Drag, resize, align, distribute, group, reorder, lock, hide, copy, paste, undo, and redo
Figma-like Auto Layout, Grid, constraints, and content-sized frames
Responsive overrides on the same Scene nodes without device-specific duplication
Official component registries with individually selectable real demos
Human annotations bound to exact Scene nodes and visual crops
Protected manual adjustments and field-level AI conflict review
Project-scoped storage with transmitted project ID isolation
Optional implementation export after visual design is complete
defaultPrompt: Create an editable landing page for my product.
Apply the pending component notes to this design.
Improve the selected section while preserving the rest.

permissions.reason: Launch the installed Web Design Studio MCP and local application service.
Export design documents and generated website files.
